title: Nikon Automated Microscopy: Label-free Timelapse Imaging in Well Plates
author: Akihiro Suto
materials: Select "Detect" in Sample Navigation Well Plate Tab
Select the correct Optical configuration for Brightfield

steps.title: Import JOBs .bin file
steps.instruction: Import the 'Timelapse with Volume Contrast v3.bin' file into the JOBs explorer.

substeps.instruction: Open JOBs Explorer via View Menu > Analysis Controls > JOBs Explorer
Import the .bin file from the provided materials

steps.title: Detect well plate
steps.instruction: Locate and configure the sample navigation window to detect the plate.

substeps.instruction: Open the Sample Navigation pane (found on the left of Compact layout, or View > Acquisition controls > Sample Navigation in advanced layouts)
Select 'Well plate holder' and check the 'well plate' checkbox

steps.title: Select and label wells
steps.instruction: Define the specific wells to be imaged and apply labels if desired.

substeps.instruction: Select the wells to image in the Sample Navigation Wellplate tab
Choose whether to label the wells using the wellplate labelling interface

steps.title: Configure and run scan
steps.instruction: Execute the scan using the imported JOB file.

substeps.instruction: Press 'scan' in the sample navigation window
Choose the previously imported JOB and scan

steps.title: Set imaging parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the capture settings for the timelapse.

substeps.instruction: Select the number of images per well (recommend limiting the working area to the center of the wells to avoid brightfield illumination variability caused by the water meniscus)
Select the number of time points and intervals to capture

steps.title: Verify scanning settings
steps.instruction: Run the JOB to check the scanning settings.
